tasks.title: Console setup posts each form's own token and completes sign out all
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, all Behavior bullets, Checks to run before handoff and Completion evidence; Required behavior 1-7, Security impact checklist, Counterexamples, Acceptance evidence 1-7 and Rollout order. Make form_token_args take an exact fixed-string action path, reset ftok first on every selection and read only the first matching form, including multiple forms on one line, with no fallback to unrelated tokens. Update every call site; both step-7 closed-setup probes must call form_token_args /setup on the sign-in page and omit form_token without an explicit reset. Only the top-level declaration and form_token_args may assign, clear or edit ftok anywhere in the script. Fetch GET /account/sessions/sign-out-all in jar A after the sessions-list assertion and expect 200 with failure text step 11 GET /account/sessions/sign-out-all before selecting csrf and the confirmation form's token for step 11. Preserve optional tokens, the intentional same-path legacy replay and every existing ok: line; extend the script header with the exact-form rule. Build the real-script PATH-stub harness with docker, curl and node, all four layouts and cases A-G, path-bound single-use token validation, private request logs, literal output assertions and secret scans on success and failure. In around, put a distinct-token <path>/x prefix decoy before the target and a distinct-token unrelated /sign-out decoy after it, all on one line; keep both factor forms adjacent with their shared token. In mixed, keep pr9 forms and order except for the tokenless /sign-in form followed by a token-bearing /sign-out decoy; other forms retain their tokens. The fake rejects any form_token sent to a form rendered without one with 409, while closed POST /setup still returns 404 before token validation. Case G exercises the token-bearing step-8 /account/authenticator selection followed directly by the tokenless step-9 /sign-in selection, without another selection or explicit reset between them; step 7 cannot conceal a missing selector reset. Prove cases B and C reject a temporary exact-to-prefix selector mutant with status 409. Also prove case G rejects the no-reset selector mutant even with an explicit clear added at step 7 in both flows. The test reports each failed case and continues all remaining cases before exiting non-zero. Add the specified lint-job step and Commands row, update the README form-token paragraph and add the test sentence. Keep console code and CI, csrf(), image/action pins and dependencies unchanged. Include old-script proof, the one-line prefix-mutant diff and failing lines, the no-reset mutant diff and case-G failing line, grep evidence for the sole ftok writers, real-stack results or the documented local limitation, and security evidence in the PR. Acceptance evidence 6 is the premerge real-stack run; evidence 7 is post-merge rollout evidence: deploy-main dev stays green, and the console PR #9 deploy-dev rerun is recorded on #722; neither requires a console commit or CI change.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; ends with 'console-setup.test: 7 cases passed'. A: two-factor/pr9, B: two-factor/around and G: two-factor/mixed finish steps 1-13. C: legacy/around includes 'ok: 8b POST /sign-in replay 409 Already submitted'. In B and C every posted-from page places the distinct-token <path>/x prefix decoy before the exact-action target and the distinct-token unrelated /sign-out decoy after it, all on one line; both /sign-in/factor forms stay adjacent and share the target token. D: legacy/none and E: legacy/mixed include 'ok: 8b replay check skipped: console without form_token'; D logs zero form_token fields and E and G log none on any POST /sign-in. In mixed, only /sign-in lacks a token, with a token-bearing /sign-out decoy after it; the fake returns 409 if any token is posted to that tokenless form. G verifies the step-8 /account/authenticator token selection immediately precedes step-9's tokenless /sign-in selection without an intervening selector call or explicit reset; every POST /account/authenticator and POST /sign-in/factor in G carries a token issued for that path. F captures script exit 1 and 'FAIL: step 11 sign out all: status 500, want 303'. All cases assert no form_token on the step-7 POST /setup, correct action binding for every submitted token, and no fixture secret in either output stream. A-E and G match literal complete ok: lists; only Checks: N. uses jq '.checks | length' on the independent full/config/api/checks.json. The harness prints 'ok: <case>' on success or 'FAIL: <case>: <reason>' on failure, continues all remaining cases and exits non-zero if any failed. Stubs use fresh per-case state, no Docker or network, and no TOTP sleep.

acceptance.command: old_worktree=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pulse-deploy-726-old.XXXXXX) && git worktree add --detach "$old_worktree" 0157775f8046dbfd18f14d153322adfa6a44ca30 && cp e2e/console-setup.test.sh "$old_worktree/e2e/console-setup.test.sh" && bash "$old_worktree/e2e/console-setup.test.sh"
acceptance.expected: non-zero exit; the unchanged new test's case A reaches step 11 on the old script and reports 'FAIL: step 11 sign out all: status 409, want 303'. A syntax error, absent helper or incomplete stub is not acceptable evidence. Record this literal failure in the PR and remove the temporary worktree after collecting it.

Acceptance evidence 3: prepare this temporary copy of the fixed script and unchanged test, preserving e2e/ and full/config/api/checks.json and any compose-file argument needed by the script. Change only the action comparison in form_token_args from exact to prefix (one line, appropriate to the implementation). The test exits non-zero and reports the script's literal 'status 409' failures in both B: two-factor/around and C: legacy/around; the unmodified fixed script passes those same cases. First-match, prefix-match and greedy-last selection must each take a decoy in around. Quote the one-line mutant diff and both failing lines in the PR. Remove the temporary copy afterward and commit none of it.

Acceptance evidence 4: prepare a temporary copy of the fixed script and unchanged test with the same layout and required files as evidence 3. Remove only the reset ftok=() inside form_token_args and add ftok=() directly before form_token_args /setup at step 7 in both flows. The test exits non-zero and names case G: two-factor/mixed with 'FAIL: step 9 wrong password: status 409, want 401'. The fixed script passes G on that same layout; a missing reset must fail despite both step-7 clears. The harness continues through G even when earlier cases fail. Quote the mutant diff and G's failing line in the PR, remove the temporary copy afterward and commit none of it.

exit 0 on the real fixed script; each listed assignment is either the top-level ftok=() declaration or between form_token_args() { and that function's closing }. The selector resets ftok=() first on every call; no call site, helper or step sets, clears or edits ftok, including both step-7 probes. Quote the output in the PR as acceptance evidence 4.

Output preserves all steps 1-13, including 'ok: 11 POST /account/sessions/sign-out-all 303', 'ok: 11 jars B and C GET / 303 Location /sign-in?next=%2F' and 'ok: 11 jar A GET / 200 Signed in as'. Only ok: lines are quoted as evidence; no secret or page body is printed. If Docker or the local stack is unavailable, record the specific limitation in the PR as allowed by Completion evidence; do not substitute a console-main run for this proof.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && git diff -- e2e/console-setup.sh e2e/console-setup.test.sh .github/workflows/ci.yml AGENTS.md README.md
acceptance.expected: exit 0; review confirms all four Security impact checklist items: no secret output and private temporary logs removed on exit; fixed-string exact action selection without evaluating HTML and one array element per encoded token; no new dependency, action, image or permission, with existing checkout SHA and persist-credentials: false preserved; fake returns closed-setup 404 before token validation and 409 for wrong-path or spent tokens, missing required tokens, or any token submitted to a tokenless form. Only the top-level declaration and selector may write ftok; both step-7 probes call form_token_args /setup without an explicit clear. The sole new workflow step follows published_port helper, is named 'console-setup form tokens (stub curl, docker, node)' and runs bash e2e/console-setup.test.sh; docs describe the exact-form rule, step-11 confirmation GET, unchanged replay/skip behavior and new test command.
exit 0; deploy PR required checks pass, including the added stub test, existing lint checks and dev auto flow against console main

exit 0; the PR names lorenzh/pulse-meta#726 and records 'console-setup.test: 7 cases passed', the old-script step-11 status-409 failure, the temporary prefix-mutant's one-line diff and status-409 failures in both cases B and C, the no-reset mutant diff (selector reset removed and both step-7 clears added) and case G's 'FAIL: step 9 wrong password: status 409, want 401', grep -n 'ftok=' e2e/console-setup.sh output confirming the sole writers, shellcheck and bun run check results, security checklist evidence, and evidence 6's real two-factor ok: lines with the console PR #9 SHA or the specific reason that local run was unavailable. It distinguishes premerge evidence from acceptance evidence 7: the required post-merge green deploy-main dev run and console PR #9 deploy-dev rerun; the latter is recorded on #722 after deploy merges, with no console commit or CI change.
